question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           t.calendar_year, 
           t.calendar_quarter_number, 
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) >= 
          SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) * 1.20
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year, 
           t.calendar_quarter_number,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
product_q4_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
grand_totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(q4_2019_sales) as q4_2019_total,
           SUM(q4_2020_sales) as q4_2020_total
    FROM product_q4_sales
),
product_share AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id,
           p.q4_2019_sales,
           p.q4_2020_sales,
           g.q4_2019_total,
           g.q4_2020_total,
           1.0 * p.q4_2019_sales / g.q4_2019_total as q4_2019_share,
           1.0 * p.q4_2020_sales / g.q4_2020_total as q4_2020_share,
           1.0 * p.q4_2020_sales / g.q4_2020_total - 1.0 * p.q4_2019_sales / g.q4_2019_total as share_change
    FROM product_q4_sales p
    CROSS JOIN grand_totals g
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           q4_2019_share,
           q4_2020_share,
           share_change,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) DESC) as percentile_rank
    FROM product_share
)
SELECT prod_id,
       ROUND(q4_2019_share, 6) as q4_2019_share,
       ROUND(q4_2020_share, 6) as q4_2020_share,
       ROUND(share_change, 6) as share_change
FROM ranked_products
WHERE percentile_rank = 5
ORDER BY share_change DESC
